_note: [SEED] M9 BIOMES (DIRECTIONS-2026-08-02-BIOMES) — guaranteed areas present in EVERY run, alongside the procedural material. Placement is ABSOLUTE world coords (the same model as sites) so a given world always reads the same; each biome is a chebyshev square region (center +/- radius) and regions MUST NOT overlap (the engine validates this by construction). Four identity channels wire off these defs: terrain `dress` ({ baseTileId: artId } — art added M9 inc2), monster/NPC pool `wanderers` + encounter `table`, and the vibe pair `weirdness` + `register` (the dominant register the prose engine leans on in-biome). The Chapel Perilous sits inside `perilous-verge` and keeps its full-collision pin. Player-facing biome flavor is generated prose ([SEED] at output); the discrete event fragments live in data/register/biomes.json.
